name: Player report UI layout - prepared disposable save

steps._note: Prepare active cooking jobs at counts 1,2,4,5,6,7,12 before each HUD capture. Inspect row-major 1/2/3/4 columns above minimap; screenshot step alone is not visual acceptance.

Select a damaged repairable item using the real inventory slot. Verify repair material icon/name/full-repair quantity and combat/backpack separation. Also inspect selected recipe and related recipes: numeric gains, no decorative arrows.
